description: Camera choreography for the No Tail Outpost cutscene. All shots assume the painted backdrop at world (0, 10, -40) with the outpost doorway around world (-6, 6, -40). Aristotle at (2, 0, 0), NoTail emerges from painted doorway and walks to (-4, 0, -8).

cameras.name: CAM_01_Establishing
cameras.description: Wide-right angle showing Aristotle on the landing pad with painted outpost centered. This is the initial shot that composes to the reference painting.

cameras.name: CAM_02_GlideBehind
cameras.description: Glide to 3/4 behind-and-above Aristotle as he walks toward the door. Painted doorway occupies the centre of frame.

cameras.name: CAM_03_OverShoulder
cameras.description: Tight over Aristotle's right shoulder. Painted doorway dominates the frame — this is where the blast door opens.

cameras.name: CAM_04_SideReveal
cameras.description: Side-slide reveal. Aristotle in right of frame, NoTail emerging from painted doorway on the left.

cameras.name: CAM_05_NoTailClose
cameras.description: Close on NoTail for her threatening opening lines.

cameras.name: CAM_06_TwoShot
cameras.description: Medium two-shot covering both characters for back-and-forth dialogue.

cameras.name: CAM_07_AristotleClose
cameras.description: Reverse-angle close on Aristotle for his responses.

lights.name: Sun
lights.note: Warm low-right angle matching painted sunset. Transform authored directly in the .tscn.
